sed -n 1,120p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -i -C 3 'dashkit|dashboard|grid|drag' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && ls src && cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/c93b8aaa-5b8e-45e6-a036-4c4abae16255/tool-results/bj0270m6m.txt; grep -n -i -A4 'dashkit' $F | sed -n 1,80p; echo ----TRAPS; awk '/^----$/{c++} c==2' $F | head -400

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/c93b8aaa-5b8e-45e6-a036-4c4abae16255/tool-results/bj0270m6m.txt; sed -n 156,176p $F; echo ----SRC; ls src; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo "== index.html"; cat index.html; echo "== tsconfig"; cat tsconfig.json; echo "== vite"; cat vite.config.ts; echo "== gitignore"; cat .gitignore; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls __agent_eval__; ls .claude

npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20 && npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDependencies' -A6 | head -20 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null | head -30 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json

npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.13.0 2>&1 | grep -v 'allow-scripts' | tail -3; grep -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; echo ----DOCS; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs | head -40; echo ----INDEX; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -150
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; wc -l $D; sed -n 150,520p $D

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; echo ==README; rg -n -i -C 6 'required setup|styles|import .*css|configure' $P/README.md | head -80; echo ==EXPORTS; cat $P/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo ==DASHKIT-PROPS; sed -n 1,200p $P/build/esm/components/DashKit.d.ts; echo ==PLUGIN; cat $P/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ==COMPONENTS; cat $P/components/index.d.ts; echo ==DASHKIT; find $P/components -maxdepth 2 -name 'DashKit*.d.ts' | head; cat $(find $P/components -maxdepth 2 -name 'DashKit.d.ts' | head -1); echo ==SETTINGS; rg -n 'SettingsProps|gridLayout|isMobile|ReactGridLayoutProps' $P/typings/common.d.ts | head -20; echo ==ACTIONPANEL; cat $(find $P/components -name 'ActionPanel.d.ts' | head -1) $(find $P/components -name 'types.d.ts' -path '*ActionPanel*' | head -1) 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ==SETITEM; rg -n 'setItem|removeItem|SetItemOptions|setSettings|registerPlugins' $P/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts $P/typings/*.d.ts $P/shared/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ==CSS; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit -name '*.css' | head; echo ==SHARED-CONFIG; sed -n 1,80p $P/shared/types/config.d.ts 2>/dev/null

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; echo ==SETTINGS; sed -n 1,60p $P/typings/common.d.ts; echo ==CONFIG-TYPINGS; cat $P/typings/config.d.ts; echo ==MENU; rg -n -A12 'export type MenuItem' $P/typings/*.d.ts; echo ==DROP; rg -n -B2 -A10 'ItemDropProps' $P/shared/types/*.d.ts | head -40; echo ==DND; cat $P/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts; echo ==RGL-CSS; rg -n "react-grid-layout.*css|\.css'" $P/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.d.ts $P/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts $P/components/GridLayout/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "css" $P/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js | head -5; ls node_modules/react-grid-layout/css 2>/dev/null; echo ==DEFAULT-MENU; rg -n -i 'MenuItems|delete|DEFAULT' $P/constants/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $P; echo ==ICONS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E '^(ChartColumn|ChartLine|Text|Heading|LayoutHeaderCells|ListUl|Gear|Pencil|Check|Xmark|TrashBin|ArrowRotateLeft|Plus|Persons|Clock|CircleCheck|TextAlignLeft|Square|LayoutCellsLarge|ArrowUp|ArrowDown|Sun|Moon|Heading1|Database|Server|CircleExclamation|TriangleExclamation|Bell|ChartAreaStacked|ChartPie|Font|ListCheck)\.js$'; echo ==UIKIT; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Progress Table Label Switch Text Button Flex Icon Box 2>&1 | head -60

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo ==MENUITEMS; cat $P/constants/common.d.ts; echo ==OVERLAY; rg -n -B2 -A14 'export type OverlayCustomControlItem' $P/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts; echo ==RGL-IN-CSS; grep -c 'react-grid-item\|react-grid-layout' $P/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.css $P/components/GridItem/GridItem.css; grep -rn 'react-grid-layout/css' $P --include=*.js | head -3; grep -rn 'react-resizable' $P/components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head -2; echo ==DEFAULT-OVERLAY; rg -n 'overlayMenuItems|MenuItems\.' $P/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -12; echo ==ONITEMEDIT; rg -n 'onItemEdit' $P/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js | head -5; echo ==UIKIT-DOCS; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo ==CARD; rg -n "view|type|size|theme" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head -20; echo ==PROGRESS; sed -n 1,60p $U/Progress/Progress.d.ts | rg -n 'value|theme|size|text|loading|stack|className' | head; echo ==TABLE; rg -n 'columns|data|getRowId|verticalAlign|width|className|emptyMessage' $U/Table/Table.d.ts | head -20; rg -n 'id|name|template|align|width' $U/Table/Table.d.ts | sed -n 1,25p; echo ==LABEL; rg -n 'theme|size' $U/Label/Label.d.ts | head -8; echo ==SWITCH; rg -n 'checked|onUpdate|content|size' $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/Checkbox/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ==TEXT; rg -n 'variant|color|ellipsis|whiteSpace' $U/Text/Text.d.ts | head -10; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|TextProps|variant" $U/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ==BUTTON; rg -n "view\?|size\?|selected|disabled|loading|onClick" $U/Button/Button.d.ts | head -10; echo ==ICON; rg -n 'data|size' $U/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -5; echo ==DEFLIST; ls $U | grep -iE '^(DefinitionList|Divider|Hotkey|Skeleton|UserLabel|Avatar|ActionTooltip|Tooltip|Select|RadioButton|SegmentedRadioGroup|Alert|Disclosure)$'

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; echo ==OVERLAY; rg -n -A12 'OverlayCustomControlItem' $P/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts | head -40; echo ==OVERLAY-ONEDIT; sed -n 170,200p $P/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.js; echo ==RGL-CSS-IMPORT; grep -rln 'react-grid-layout/css\|react-resizable/css' $P node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/cjs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n 'react-grid-item\b' $P/components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head -3; echo ==PROGRESS; cat $U/Progress/Progress.d.ts | head -40; echo ==SWITCH; cat $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts; sed -n 1,30p $U/Checkbox/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg -n 'ControlProps' -A14 $U/types.d.ts | head -30; echo ==CONFIGURE; rg -n 'configure|Lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts | head; echo ==I18N; ls $P/i18n; rg -n 'ru' $P/i18n/*.js | head -3; echo ==THEME; rg -n 'useTheme|ThemeProvider' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head; echo ==DEFLIST; sed -n 1,40p $U/DefinitionList/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | rg -n 'items|name|content|direction|responsive|nameMaxWidth' | head; echo ==SELECT; rg -n 'value\?|onUpdate|options\?|size\?|width\?|renderControl' $U/Select/types.d.ts | head -8

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo ==CONFIGURE; rg -n 'export' $U/components/utils/configure.d.ts $U/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $U -name 'configure.d.ts' | head -2; echo ==PROGRESS-TYPES; cat $U/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ==README-CSS; rg -n -i "css|style" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -10; echo ==RGL-PKG; grep '"version"' node_modules/react-grid-layout/package.json; echo ==DEFLIST; sed -n 1,40p $U/components/DefinitionList/types.d.ts; echo ==LAYOUT-REF; rg -n -C2 'spacing\(|sp\(' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -30

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $P/plugins/index.d.ts; echo ==TITLE; cat $P/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts | head -40; echo ==TEXT; cat $P/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; echo ==GRIDITEM-CSS; sed -n 1,45p $P/components/GridItem/GridItem.css; echo ==ITEM-CSS; cat $P/components/Item/Item.css | head -30
